name: web-frosted-blue-grey-banking-dashboards-staggered
title: Frosted Blue-Grey Banking Dashboards
whatItIs: Three desktop banking dashboards staggered across a white canvas, pale frosted panels with blue-grey blur gradients, sidebars, a big balance, a card, transaction tables and bar charts.
whatItMeans: Frosted layers and a cool blue palette feel calm and secure. The stagger shows multiple screens without needing a grid.
techniques: Blurred blue smudge across the header of each window
Nested translucent cards inside an app shell
Hatched highlighted bar in the chart
Screens offset and cropped at the right edge
White background so the glass reads as light

vocabulary.definition: The frame of sidebar and header around content.
Multiple screens offset to imply a flow.
A translucent card that shows a blurred backdrop.
